title: GitOps deployment decorator
description: A Kubernetes deployment decorator made through GitOps: the standard deployment record plus, in data.gitops, how the Platform Connector made the change (repository, pull request, commit) and who asked for it through CALM Hub.

gitops.description: How the deployment was made through Git and Flux, and on whose request.

connector.description: The CALM Hub extension that made the deployment and keeps this record, e.g. platform-connector.

environment.description: The environment deployed to, as the connector names it (e.g. local, staging, production).

repository.description: Web URL of the service repository Flux deploys from.

pull-request.description: The pull request that carried the change: the change gate.

commit.description: The commit on the deployed branch that Flux applied.

requested-by.description: Who asked for the deployment: the subject CALM Hub vouched for.

hub-audit-id.description: The id (jti) of the CALM Hub call that asked for the deployment: its entry in CALM Hub's audit log.
